about.title: Not just a gym. A fitness family.
about.text:
Iron Pulse Fitness has 4,000 sq ft of training space with imported strength equipment, a full cardio zone and a separate yoga & Zumba studio.

Every new member gets a free body-composition check and a diet plan from our certified trainers.
